name: Flugrettung: Die Simulation
summary: Flugrettung: Die Simulation is a helicopter flight rescue simulation where players assume the role of an air rescue pilot leading a team of emergency doctors, paramedics, and dog handlers. Players navigate over 100 rescue missions including avalanches, car accidents, and industrial fires, making strategic decisions in time-critical situations. The game features realistic flight physics, 3D landscapes with map-based navigation, and detailed graphics designed to create an immersive rescue operation experience.
